_comment: Single-unit seed for the Unit Animation Viewer (ADR-0024). The viewer reconfigures this one unit in-place via the debug panel — changing job, gender, and equipment through the production paths (unit.change_job + unit_progression.equip_item) rather than spawning prebaked variants. The seed is intentionally minimal: a level-1 Male Squire with no weapon. Everything else is set at runtime by the panel.
